scope: Nine bounded coordinate workloads frozen before generation or original/native calls; all gains and losses retained. No full-library or prior-C++ performance claim.
timed_boundary: Whole public call including literal negative check, NumPy round/int conversion/transpose, owned zero-fill/scatter, output allocation and output destruction. Coordinate generation, independent oracle and parity guards are outside timing.
independent_oracle: Decode actual logical coordinate words; Python nearest-even round for finite exact quarter-grid values; reverse point order, first unseen flat offset wins, uint64 point+1 packed into a zero bytearray. No original/native labeler or NumPy round/index assignment used.
frontier: Ordinary finite nonnegative exact ndarray coordinates and positive integer tuple shapes. Invalid/protocol/scalar/exceptional inputs remain outside this timing matrix; sparse allocation-cost losses are included.
